# Arekas — full reference

> Arekas is a nature destination in Rajanukunte, North Bangalore (near Yelahanka), Karnataka, India. It has two brands on one farm property: **Arekas Arena**, a 2.5 acre outdoor event venue for weddings, engagements, birthdays, corporate events and private gatherings (up to 500 guests), and **Arekas Bamboo Arcadia**, a farm stay with handcrafted bamboo cottages, a swimming pool and open-air dining. Both are operated by KR Endeavours.

## Key facts

- Venue address: Arekere Village, Rajanukunte, 2nd Hobli, Yelahanka Taluk, Bengaluru, Karnataka 562163, India
- Coordinates: 13.1149, 77.5499 (north of Yelahanka, reached via Bellary Road / NH44)
- Nearby areas: Yelahanka, Doddaballapur, Jakkur, Hebbal, Devanahalli, Thanisandra, Vidyaranyapura
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 89511 26633
- Email (events): arekas.arena@gmail.com
- Email (farm stay): bambooblissfarmstay@gmail.com
- Property: 2.5 acres of arecanut palms, bamboo groves, open lawn, koi pond
- Event capacity: up to 500 guests
- Dining: 3,000 sq ft bamboo dining pavilion; 100+ seated, 250–300 buffet/cocktail
- Stage: 500 sq ft; dedicated bride & groom rooms near the stage
- Accommodation: 4 bamboo cottages + 2 dormitories (about 28–30 guests)
- Facilities: swimming pool, on-site temple, bonfire area, pergola, koi pond, on-site parking
- Legal entity: KR Endeavours, GSTIN 29ABFFK2060G1ZF, No. 42, 7th Cross, Patel Pille, Ramchandrapura, Vidyaranyapura, Bengaluru 560097

## Pricing (INR)

- Arekas Arena 12-hour package: ₹1,80,000 for up to 500 guests (accommodation charged separately)
- Arekas Arena 24-hour package: ₹3,50,000 for up to 500 guests (accommodation complimentary)
- Both packages include full venue hire (lawn, stage, dining pavilion), Nadaswaram team, Dhol team, event planners and an event host. 50% advance to book.
- Add-ons: buffet catering from ~₹490 per plate; decoration from ₹42,000 (up to ₹1,00,000 for 24-hour events); photography ₹25,000–₹35,000 (up to ₹1,00,000 for 24-hour events)
- Bamboo Arcadia cottage: ₹5,999 per night for 2 adults
- Bamboo Arcadia dormitory: ₹25,000 per night for up to 10 adults

## Cancellation & refund policy

### Arekas Arena (events)
- The 50% booking advance is non-refundable.
- Cancelled 30+ days before the event: deposit non-refundable; catering/decor extras may be refunded.
- Cancelled within 30 days of the event: 100% non-refundable.
- Rescheduling must be requested at least 45 days in advance, subject to date availability.

### Arekas Bamboo Arcadia (cottages)
- 7 or more days before check-in: 100% refund minus processing fee.
- 3 to 7 days before check-in: 50% refund.
- Within 72 hours, no-show or early departure: no refund.

### General
- Force majeure: a full credit note valid 12 months or a full refund, at management's discretion.
- Eligible refunds are processed within 7–10 business days to the original payment method (bank transfer, UPI or card).

## How to book

Message on WhatsApp at +91 89511 26633 or email arekas.arena@gmail.com with the event type, date and guest count. Enquiry forms are on https://arekas.in/.

## Frequently asked questions

### Is Arekas Arena a wedding venue in Bangalore?
Yes. Arekas Arena is a nature-focused outdoor wedding venue in Rajanukunte, North Bangalore. The 2.5 acre property includes an open lawn, bamboo dining pavilion, stage, cottages, swimming pool and other outdoor spaces suitable for weddings and celebrations.

### How many guests can Arekas Arena accommodate?
Arekas Arena can accommodate events of up to 500 guests. The dining pavilion can seat more than 100 guests and accommodate approximately 250–300 guests in buffet or cocktail-style arrangements.

### Where is Arekas Arena located?
Arekas Arena is located in Arekere Village, Rajanukunte, Yelahanka Taluk, Bengaluru, Karnataka 562163 — close to Yelahanka and reachable from Doddaballapur, Jakkur, Hebbal, Devanahalli, Thanisandra and Vidyaranyapura.

### Does Arekas Arena have accommodation?
Yes. The property has four couple cottages and two dormitory cottages, with accommodation for approximately 30 guests.

### Does Arekas Arena have a swimming pool?
Yes. The property has a swimming pool available to guests.

### Is Arekas Arena suitable for corporate events?
Yes. The property is suitable for corporate events, team-building activities, workshops, conferences, product launches and corporate outings.

### Does Arekas Arena have parking?
Yes. Arekas Arena provides on-site parking for guest vehicles as part of the 2.5 acre property.

### What facilities does Arekas Arena have?
The property has a swimming pool, on-site temple, bamboo groves, koi pond, bonfire area, open lawn, stage, pergola and a bamboo dining pavilion.

### Is Arekas Arena a good outdoor wedding venue near Bangalore?
Yes. Arekas Arena is a 2.5 acre nature venue with an open lawn, bamboo dining pavilion, stage, cottages and swimming pool, purpose-built for outdoor weddings.

### Where can I host a 300-person outdoor wedding near Bangalore?
Arekas Arena accommodates up to 500 guests, making it suitable for a 300-person outdoor wedding as well as smaller, intimate ceremonies.

### Can wedding guests stay overnight at Arekas Arena?
Yes. The 24-hour venue package includes complimentary accommodation, and the property's four couple cottages and two dormitories can host wedding guests overnight.

### Are there dedicated bride and groom rooms?
Yes. Dedicated bride & groom rooms are available near the stage for getting-ready and between-ceremony rest.

### What are the best farm wedding venues near Bangalore?
Arekas Arena is one of the few venues near Bangalore that combines a genuine working farm setting — arecanut palms, bamboo groves and open lawns — with full wedding infrastructure and on-site accommodation.

### Is Arekas Arena a good birthday party venue in North Bangalore?
Yes. Arekas Arena hosts both kids' and adult birthday celebrations, with a swimming pool, farm activities, open lawns and a dining pavilion.

### Can I host a pool party for a birthday at Arekas Arena?
Yes. The on-site swimming pool is available to guests and works well as the centrepiece for a pool-themed birthday party.

### What are the best birthday party venues in North Bangalore?
For a farm-set birthday with a pool and open lawns rather than a banquet hall, Arekas Arena in Rajanukunte is a strong option in North Bangalore.

### Where can I have a corporate team outing near Bangalore?
Arekas Arena is used for team outings, offsites, workshops, conferences and product launches, with open-air spaces and on-site accommodation for overnight offsites.

### Does Arekas Arena offer accommodation for corporate offsites?
Yes. The property has 4 couple cottages and 2 dormitory cottages, accommodating approximately 30 guests for teams staying overnight.

### What are some outdoor event venues in North Bangalore for offsites?
Arekas Arena is a 2.5 acre outdoor venue in North Bangalore with breakout spaces, a dining pavilion and on-site accommodation, suited to corporate offsites and workshops.

### How much does Arekas Arena cost?
Venue packages start at ₹1,80,000 for 12 hours for up to 500 guests, and ₹3,50,000 for 24 hours for up to 500 guests.

### What is included in Arekas Arena's event packages?
Every package includes full venue access, a Nadasaram team, Dhol team, event planners and an event host, with 50% advance booking.

### Does the price include catering and decoration?
No — catering, decoration and photography are add-ons. Buffet catering runs from about ₹490 per plate, decoration from ₹42,000, and photography from ₹25,000.

### Is accommodation included in the price?
Accommodation is complimentary with the 24-hour package. With the 12-hour package, it is charged separately.

### What is the cost of a 500-person outdoor event venue in Bangalore?
At Arekas Arena, hosting up to 500 guests is included in both the 12-hour (₹1,80,000) and 24-hour (₹3,50,000) packages, with no extra per-guest charge up to that capacity.

### What is Arekas Bamboo Arcadia?
Arekas Bamboo Arcadia is our farm-stay brand — handcrafted bamboo cottages on the same property, offering a nature retreat separate from event hosting.

### Where can I find a farm stay near Bangalore?
Arekas Bamboo Arcadia in Rajanukunte, North Bangalore offers a genuine farm stay with handcrafted bamboo cottages, a swimming pool and open-air dining.

### Where can I host a private party in a farm setting near Bangalore?
For smaller private parties, we host guests at Arekas Bamboo Arcadia — bamboo cottages, a pool and open-air dining among arecanut palms.

### Can I combine an event with an overnight cottage stay?
Yes. Guests can combine an event at Arekas Arena with a stay at Arekas Bamboo Arcadia for multi-day celebrations.

### Is Arekas Arena close to Yelahanka?
Yes. Arekas Arena is in Rajanukunte, just north of Yelahanka, and is also reachable from Doddaballapur, Jakkur, Hebbal, Devanahalli, Thanisandra and Vidyaranyapura.

### Which event venues near Yelahanka have a swimming pool?
Arekas Arena, near Yelahanka in Rajanukunte, has an on-site swimming pool available to guests.
